books = []

rating_map = {
    "One": 1,
    "Two": 2,
    "Three": 3,
    "Four": 4,
    "Five": 5
}

for item in _items:

    data = item["json"]

    titles = data["first_title"]
    prices = data["prices"]
    availability = data["availability"]
    ratings = data["ratings"]

    for i in range(len(titles)):

        rating_class = ratings[i]["class"]
        rating = rating_map[rating_class.split()[-1]]
        price_text = prices[i].strip()

        price_value = float(price_text.replace("£", ""))

        book = {
            "title": titles[i],
            "price": price_text,
            "price_gbp": price_value,
            "availability": availability[i].strip(),
            "rating": rating
        }

        books.append({"json": book})

return books

seen_books = set()

for item in _items:
    book = item["json"]

    title = book["title"].strip().lower()
    price = book["price"].strip()

    book_key = title

    if book_key in seen_books:
        book["duplicate_status"] = "Duplicate"
    else:
        seen_books.add(book_key)
        book["duplicate_status"] = "Unique"

return _items

total_books = len(_items)

valid_books = 0
invalid_books = 0
unique_books = 0
duplicate_books = 0

total_price = 0
price_count = 0

for item in _items:
    book = item["json"]

    if book["validation_status"] == "Valid":
        valid_books += 1
    else:
        invalid_books += 1

    if book["duplicate_status"] == "Unique":
        unique_books += 1
    else:
        duplicate_books += 1

    try:
        price = float(book["price"].replace("£", "").strip())
        total_price += price
        price_count += 1
    except (ValueError, AttributeError, KeyError):
        pass

average_price = 0

if price_count > 0:
    average_price = round(total_price / price_count, 2)

report = {
    "total_books": total_books,
    "valid_books": valid_books,
    "invalid_books": invalid_books,
    "unique_books": unique_books,
    "duplicate_books": duplicate_books,
    "average_price_gbp": average_price
}

return [{"json": report}]
